challenges.desc:
Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh là đô thị đặc biệt của cả nước, có lợi thế về cơ sở hạ tầng thương mại - dịch vụ, có nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao và là cửa ngõ quốc tế, giao lưu thương mại, dịch vụ, du lịch với các nước trong khu vực và thế giới.
Với hơn 300 năm hình thành và phát triển, bên cạnh những giá trị văn hóa truyền thống đặc sắc của Việt Nam qua hàng ngàn năm dựng nước và giữ nước, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh đã hình thành cho riêng mình những bản sắc độc đáo với những câu chuyện bất tận về văn hoá, lịch sử, vùng đất, con người.  
Thành phố đang bước vào những ngày cuối năm - khoảng thời gian mà không khí lễ hội đang rộn ràng trên từng góc phố, nhiều không gian trải nghiệm sống động phục vụ người dân và du khách với chuỗi sự kiện du lịch, thể thao, âm nhạc, nghệ thuật đặc sắc, mang tính trải nghiệm cao cùng nhiều chương trình kích cầu du lịch, kích cầu mua sắm triển khai đồng bộ tại trung tâm Thành phố náo nức đón chào du khách trong và ngoài nước.

contents.desc: @Besuto Sydney and the menu by incredible Chef @Michiake_miyazake was hands down one of the best omakase experiences we’ve had, definitely on our top in Sydney! It reminded us of a true traditional Japanese Omakase restaurant. This fine-dining restaurant only seats 8 people so book in advance if you plan to come here - they release booking dates 1st of the month for the following month. I highly, highly recommend this!
The menu varies depending on the fresh produce available on the day but we were given 13 courses and highlights for me:
Chawanmushi - WA Marron, TAS Short Spine Sea Urchin, IKURA Salmon Roe, Lobster Shellfish Oil
Grilled Green Asparagus, Onsen Egg with Black Truffle Oil, Pickled Wasabi Stems
Tooth fish - Green Tea Smoked Patagonian Toothfish (Yuzu miso marinated)
Gunkan-QLD Spanner Crab, TAS Sea Urchin, IKURA Salmon Roe

contents.desc: @calvinscrepes do the CRAZIEST belgian milk chocolate waterfalls I’ve ever seen on their hotcakes and waffles. They’re a dessert bar and cafe that opens till midnight and they’ve got several locations: Belmore, Smithfield and Liverpool. We tried these desserts at their Belmore location.
Chocolate pistachio crepe $25 (perfect for those viral dubai chocolate lovers)
Not featured in this video was their strawberries dipped in chocolate which is a classic - their strawberries are super juicy and sweet!

If you’re looking for a late night dessert spot in Sydney that’s unique, theatrical and doesn’t hold back on any chocolate sauce - this is your best bet! Portion sizes are huge and perfect for sharing too. They’ve also got a selection of ice cream to choose from if that’s more your thing.

contents.desc: Top Ryde City Centre is the place to celebrate Lunar New Year and welcome the Year of the Snake. With free entertainment and festive traditions, it’s the perfect destination for a day out with the family.

Marvel at the magical lantern display, enjoy the excitement of the lion dance performance, and experience a fascinating reptile show featuring Australian snakes—both thrilling and educational. Kids will love the Chinese zodiac-themed face painting, adding an extra touch of fun to the festivities.

After soaking up the celebrations, there’s no better way to round out the day than with a meal at one of the many restaurants offering a variety of Asian cuisines. With kid-friendly menus and endless options for all budgets, everyone will leave satisfied.
Don’t miss this vibrant celebration happening from 29 Jan – 12 Feb. Visit their website for details: www.toprydecity.com.au/whats-on/lunar-new-year

contents.desc: Finally starting my @Linea teeth aligner journey to straighten my teeth. LINEA specialise in Clear Aligners as well as Veneers, they’re Australian-owned and Dentist Directed which is why my dentist at Meili Dental Care recommended them to me over other invisible aligner alternatives (P.S For $100 off your treatment plan, check out the link in my bio 🫶)

In this video I’m doing my initial dental visit which includes an X-ray, scans, photos of my teeth as well as a suitability assessment. Then later I received my treatment plan via the LINEA App which even showed me a 3D simulation of what my teeth will look like at every level of my treatment.
Once I was happy with the plan, they ordered my custom-fit aligners and a few weeks later when they were ready for pick-up I returned to get the buttons on my teeth so they could grip my aligners.

Everyone’s treatment plan is different depending on your case so it’s best to take an assessment first to see if you’re the right fit. If you are there will be 3 tiers of pricing depending on your case and in my instance I’m a Tier 2 which is:
FYI, at the start of the year I got a quote for Invisalign which is double this price. So the affordability, easy process and the fact that it is dentist-directed definitely won me over to LINEA.

contents.desc: @S’more Bistro has been on our wishlist for so long and we finally came here to celebrate Will’s birthday 🥳🎉 We’re actually huge fans of Chef Sam Young who’s worked at some of our favourite places like Mr Wong, Ms G’s, Totti’s and their signature BSY Lobster Pasta is what we were most excited to try.

- Pickled cucumbers, pi de sapo melon, fennel salt
- Sweet and sour pork rib aged vinegar caramel
- O’conner grass fed bone in sirloin ⭐️
- Housemade XO clay pot fried rice
And we were also given a complimentary dessert which was a beautiful Tasmanian Cherry Black Forest Tiramisu ⭐️

contents.desc: @Yolie's Patisserie is a home baker specialising in handmade mochi and WOWWWWW this may be my new favourite mochi in Sydney! To order you have to DM their page and I arranged for pick-up in Strathfield but they do offer other pick-up or delivery options too.
There’s a minimum order of 4 pieces and the price depends on the flavour you choose which changes seasonally. Highly recommend getting a Mix & Match Box.
Here are all the mochi flavours I tried:
Melon Mango $6.25/ea - Refreshing mango and watermelon indulgence. ⭐
Ruby Peach $6.25/ea - Juicy peach filling wrapped in silky soft mochi. ⭐
Moonlit Rose $6.80/ea - Lychee, pistachio cream, and a hint of rose for a magical bite. ⭐
Tropical Glow $6.20/ea- Mango, grapefruit, and creamy tropical vibes. ⭐
Double Berry $6.85/ea - Sweet strawberry and tangy raspberry mascarpone bliss.
Matcha Mochi $6.85/ea- A dreamy blend of matcha, mascarpone, and white chocolate.
Tira Bliss $6.24/ea - Coffee, ladyfingers, and mascarpone in mochi form.

contents.desc: @Innit Cafe and Bar is Sydney’s first Omakase Cocktails which now features a Fairytale Themed Experience called ‘Once Upon a Time’. They have just released new slots today for January 2025 and additional December 2024 slots for their fully sold out experience! You can now make a booking via their website: https://www.innitcafeandbar.com/book-omakase-cocktails.
What’s included in the ‘Once Upon a Time’ Omakase Cocktail Experience ($129 per person):
⭐ Course 1: Classy Lady (yuzu sake-based cocktail) + Kingfish Ceviche, Sweet Potato Crisp, and Fresh Chilli
⭐ Course 2: Pure Passion (gin-based cocktail) + Mango Avocado Rose Salad, Salmon Aburi with Mango Purée Dressing
⭐ Course 3: You Just Started (Aperol-based cocktail) + Steamed Dumplings on Chilli Mayo Sauce with Potato Crisp
⭐ Course 4: Midori Sour (midori-based cocktail) + Mushroom Risotto with Grilled Asparagus
⭐ Course 5: Innit Gimlet (gin infused kaffir lime leaves based cocktail) + Signature Prawn Pasta: squid ink pasta with in-house prawn head sauce and fresh tiger prawn
⭐ Course 6: Snow in Summer (vodka-based cocktail) + Ricotta French Toast: brioche, mascarpone, in-house strawberry jam, and fresh berries

This was such a unique omakase in Sydney that is extremely great value for what you get, highly recommend enjoying this as a date night or with friends since it’s an intimate dining experience that takes you through a journey of fairytales!
Note: Both the cocktails and tasting menu items are seasonal and may vary for future courses.

Overall, this was an amazing cruise for a family with littles!

contents.desc: We headed on an awesome family-friendly day trip from Sydney to an alpaca farm with @Experience Oz
We did the “Brunch with the Bunch” which is a 2-hour experience (www.experienceoz.com.au/en/canberra/brunch-with-the-bunch-alpaca-experience) that includes:
- A chance to meet and pet one of our handsome llamas.
- A delicious brunch to enjoy in the picnic areas
- Group talk by their guided tour guides
- A visit to The Blackwattle Farm Shop which is full of yarns, wools, fibre, roving, packs, gifts, toys and goodies galore!
- Cafe Style Brunch includes bacon, scrambled eggs, grilled tomato, grilled mushrooms, spinach, hash brown and bread roll.
- Beverages: tea, coffee, hot chocolate or juice box (for the kids).
- Infants (under 12 months)  – Free with paying adult

I highly recommend this Alpaca Farm Sydney Day Trip for the family. We did the 10:30am session which was perfect for the little ones and they napped the whole way home! You won’t find another picnic experience gift like this! Please note that this experience runs every second Sunday.

contents.desc: @Thy Thy Hair and Beauty is a luxury head spa in Sydney that specialises in traditional Vietnamese techniques to massage your scalp and nurture your hair.
The treatment I got in this video is the Combo Package - Luxury Head Treatment 60min + 30min body massage for $125 (90 mins total)

I also love that there is a luxury head spa like this in Western Sydney and open 7 days a week until 9pm because most of the ones I’ve been to are closer to the CBD or close early. So if you live close to Cabramatta this is a great local beauty salon option for you.
The treatments are also all unisex so this is perfect for a couples date night too!

contents.desc: Parramatta Park’s Wistaria Gardens now in full bloom 🌸 You can enter the park at any time or join their FREE Flower Festival - here are all the details:
* WHEN: 21 Sep 2024, 10:00 am until 22 Sep 2024, 04:00 pm
Roll out the picnic blanket and enjoy live music in Parramatta’s much-loved Wistaria Gardens this September, when the annual floral displays of cherry blossoms and wisteria bloom.
Food and drink: Coffee and snacks will be available to purchase or bring along your own picnic!
Live music: Let the good times roll and immerse yourself with feel-good music across the weekend.

Activities: Join us for a day of inspiring and educational experiences for all ages. Kids can get creative at our ‘Art and Nature Connection’ stall, making beautiful flower-inspired art. Explore cultural traditions with activities that highlight the deep connection of First Nations people to the land, and spark curiosity at our ‘Science and Nature Connection’ stall with fun, hands-on science experiments.
Tour: Take a guided tour led by a horticulturist and enjoy a walk-through colourful display of spring flowers while learning about the plants in bloom.
Shop: Check out our nature-inspired art pieces to add a natural touch to your home. You’ll also find a range of bee and honey products, plus other eco-friendly items.

Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh là đô thị đặc biệt của cả nước, có lợi thế về cơ sở hạ tầng thương mại - dịch vụ, có nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao và là cửa ngõ quốc tế, giao lưu thương mại, dịch vụ, du lịch với các nước trong khu vực và thế giới.
Với hơn 300 năm hình thành và phát triển, bên cạnh những giá trị văn hóa truyền thống đặc sắc của Việt Nam qua hàng ngàn năm dựng nước và giữ nước, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh đã hình thành cho riêng mình những bản sắc độc đáo với những câu chuyện bất tận về văn hoá, lịch sử, vùng đất, con người.  
Thành phố đang bước vào những ngày cuối năm - khoảng thời gian mà không khí lễ hội đang rộn ràng trên từng góc phố, nhiều không gian trải nghiệm sống động phục vụ người dân và du khách với chuỗi sự kiện du lịch, thể thao, âm nhạc, nghệ thuật đặc sắc, mang tính trải nghiệm cao cùng nhiều chương trình kích cầu du lịch, kích cầu mua sắm triển khai đồng bộ tại trung tâm Thành phố náo nức đón chào du khách trong và ngoài nước.

contents.desc: Another Place in Potts Point is now making the viral Dubai Chocolate into a latte or a bagel! I honestly came here to try their latte and they surprised me with the bagel, I liked the bagel even more 😂

Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh là đô thị đặc biệt của cả nước, có lợi thế về cơ sở hạ tầng thương mại - dịch vụ, có nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao và là cửa ngõ quốc tế, giao lưu thương mại, dịch vụ, du lịch với các nước trong khu vực và thế giới.
Với hơn 300 năm hình thành và phát triển, bên cạnh những giá trị văn hóa truyền thống đặc sắc của Việt Nam qua hàng ngàn năm dựng nước và giữ nước, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh đã hình thành cho riêng mình những bản sắc độc đáo với những câu chuyện bất tận về văn hoá, lịch sử, vùng đất, con người.  
Thành phố đang bước vào những ngày cuối năm - khoảng thời gian mà không khí lễ hội đang rộn ràng trên từng góc phố, nhiều không gian trải nghiệm sống động phục vụ người dân và du khách với chuỗi sự kiện du lịch, thể thao, âm nhạc, nghệ thuật đặc sắc, mang tính trải nghiệm cao cùng nhiều chương trình kích cầu du lịch, kích cầu mua sắm triển khai đồng bộ tại trung tâm Thành phố náo nức đón chào du khách trong và ngoài nước.

Free event - no tickets required. Parking is also free for 3 hours.
Ice Skate Rink: Open daily 11am-3pm and every Friday & Saturday night 5:30-8:30pm
Kids Glow Disco: Every Friday & Saturday 5:30-8:30pm
Glow in the dark face painting: Every Friday & Saturday 5:30-8pm
Children with show size greater than 9 can join in on the free ice skate rink. Bookings not required.

Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh là đô thị đặc biệt của cả nước, có lợi thế về cơ sở hạ tầng thương mại - dịch vụ, có nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao và là cửa ngõ quốc tế, giao lưu thương mại, dịch vụ, du lịch với các nước trong khu vực và thế giới.
Với hơn 300 năm hình thành và phát triển, bên cạnh những giá trị văn hóa truyền thống đặc sắc của Việt Nam qua hàng ngàn năm dựng nước và giữ nước, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh đã hình thành cho riêng mình những bản sắc độc đáo với những câu chuyện bất tận về văn hoá, lịch sử, vùng đất, con người.  
Thành phố đang bước vào những ngày cuối năm - khoảng thời gian mà không khí lễ hội đang rộn ràng trên từng góc phố, nhiều không gian trải nghiệm sống động phục vụ người dân và du khách với chuỗi sự kiện du lịch, thể thao, âm nhạc, nghệ thuật đặc sắc, mang tính trải nghiệm cao cùng nhiều chương trình kích cầu du lịch, kích cầu mua sắm triển khai đồng bộ tại trung tâm Thành phố náo nức đón chào du khách trong và ngoài nước.

Với hơn 300 năm hình thành và phát triển, bên cạnh những giá trị văn hóa truyền thống đặc sắc của Việt Nam qua hàng ngàn năm dựng nước và giữ nước, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh đã hình thành cho riêng mình những bản sắc độc đáo với những câu chuyện bất tận về văn hoá, lịch sử, vùng đất, con người.  
Thành phố đang bước vào những ngày cuối năm - khoảng thời gian mà không khí lễ hội đang rộn ràng trên từng góc phố, nhiều không gian trải nghiệm sống động phục vụ người dân và du khách với chuỗi sự kiện du lịch, thể thao, âm nhạc, nghệ thuật đặc sắc, mang tính trải nghiệm cao cùng nhiều chương trình kích cầu du lịch, kích cầu mua sắm triển khai đồng bộ tại trung tâm Thành phố náo nức đón chào du khách trong và ngoài nước.

I’ll definitely come back and try more dishes next time I’m in Saigon!!

contents.desc: My mum and I did a resin workshop at @Art Masterclass which is one of the most highly rated workshops in Sydney and it was definitely deserving of 5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The workshop ran for 2 hours, it included 1 resin cheesboard and 2 trinket trays (we just went for the cheeseboard), complimentary tea and turkish delights. It took us approximately 2 hours and it was completely beginner-friendly thanks to their experienced resin artist who patiently took us through the whole process.

This was the perfect mummy-daughter date or even date night activity in Sydney. It's a workshop that is a little different from other resin workshops because you can actually decorate it with their famous mosaic tiles too! I highly recommend checking this out or purchasing it as an experience gift for a friend 😊

contents.desc: @TheOrchardPenrith is less than an hour from Sydney CBD and it’s such a hidden gem! It’s a family-friendly and dog-friendly Orange Orchard with a playground, food kiosks and cafes where you could easily spend an entire day with your kids 🧡
There’s a free carpark on-site and no entrance fee. My family and I came here on a Sunday, here are some tips:
- The Orchard is fairly flat and venues have accessible ramps so bring your pram if you have one
- Pack hats, sunscreen and water bottles for the kids because they’ll want to run around all-day!
- The Farmhouse was very busy around breakfast time, I’d recommend making a reservation in advance if you can and DEFINITELY order the freshly squeezed orange juice!
- Locals were also telling me the triple cheese toasties from The General Store is a must-try, I’ll have to come back to try it! 😋
If you’re looking for a fun kids activity with your family, I highly recommend spending a day with them at The Orchard, Penrith

contents.desc: I finally tried the viral fried chicken at @Gami Chicken and Beer 🍗
Their Cheese Corndue ($45) is THE BEST combination of Korean Fried Chicken and corn-based cheese fondue. It’s awesome as a sharing dish.
Potato Heaven ($16.50) is basically all the best potato things in one! Creamy mashed potato, crispy wedges with sweet chilli and sour cream 🤤
And if they have an awesome Bargain Meals menu, I highly recommend the Crispy Maryland Steak ($13.50) which is a huge crispy boneless chicken piece with mash and salad.
The Chicken Burger Light ($9.90) is amazing bang for your buck and just as crispy as the Crispy Maryland Chicken
The Bibimbap ($16) is a lighter and more refreshing meal if you’re after something lighter with plenty of veg.

contents.desc: @Little Amigos Kids Cafe opened they indoor play centre in Carlingford last year and a lot of people have told me it’s one of their favourite kids play centres in Sydney!

It’s one of the most spacious play centres we’ve been to and the facilities are really new and well maintained. They’ve got interactive play areas, train that runs every half hour, zookeeper arcade games and role play areas like a supermarket, firetruck, kitchen, ice cream truck and dress up area.
The ball pit includes an interactive screen, wide open padded play gym areas and a range of slides.
And all day passes start from $5.80 for adults and $12 for kids, plus you get a free drink voucher and babies under 6 months are free.
They’ve got 3 different party packages starting from $799 and you can add on services like party decorations, cake, photography and face painting!
We really enjoyed our time here at Little Amigos in Carlingford and would definitely be back!

contents.desc: Tonight I popped by @Spicetown the new night food market (serving all halal certified food!) that just opened in Sefton open every Thu- Sun 4pm til late. Herre are some notable foods to try!

I imagine it’ll get busier at night but going around that time was great today 😊 highly recommend checking them out!! Located super close to the train station too.

contents.desc: I used to think all açai places in Sydney tasted the same… but @Island Acai opened in Burwood and I RAN 🏃They’re open on level 1 in the food court and I tried their 3 signature bowls which come in 3 sizes:  Mini $9.50, Medium $15, Large $18.

Most açai places around Sydney use the same brand of açai which doesn’t quite hit the spot for me after eating my weight in açai bowls in Hawaii LOL so I was skeptical, but WoWwwW, Island Açai has THAT premium açai taste. Apparently, it’s the only place in Sydney that uses the TROPICOOL brand which is a PREMIUM grade açai which is why it tastes so different and so darn good.

Out of all the ones I tried, I think my heart is with their Original Signature Bowl with Peanut Butter 🤤 This is really THE BEST ACAI IN SYDNEY GUYS!!  #IslandAcai #burwoodeats #burwoodfood #burwoodwestfield #sydneyacai #sydneyacaibowls #acaisydney

contents.desc: I tried 5 perfumes from @Fairia Australia and found my perfect scent! 🌹🍃 FAIRIA is a clean fragrance brand in Sydney that specialises in clean perfumes that are safe, non toxic, cruelty free and gentle on our bodies. contents.desc: Summer Express at @South Eveleigh is a free family friendly event now on every Tue - Sat until the 23rd Dec!

We went here on a Saturday and enjoyed kid friendly activities like their trackless train ride, Play Town ring toss games, kids play areas, and roving performers including Santa, hula hoopers, face painting and balloon artists.
This is a pram friendly all-in-one hub which includes plenty of parking (free for 2 hours on weekends) and pram friendly as well as dog friendly venues like BrewDog
To see what’s on at Summer Express visit southeveleigh.com and enjoy your fun family day out! #southeveleigh #summerexpress #SESsummerexpress #kidsactivitysydney #christmassydney #sydneyevent

contents.desc: Tada Kids Cafe in Lidcombe is one of my favourite kids cafes! They’ve got so many different activities that are a mix between learning and playing with fine motor skill activities, interactive technology or just for fun! We’ve had days where Felix will just want to play for 3 hours straight and still get upset when it’s time to go home 😂 but with great cafe options (that he will ACTUALLY eat) for Felix and for me too, I don’t mind hanging out here at all. And yes, there are halal food options 👏
I couldn’t film this, but the parents room is also very clean with kids changing facilities too.
This is definitely a great option just for mums or dads in the inner west that want to drop by with their kids or if you’re looking for somewhere to host a kids party in Sydney.

Disclaimer: This is a sponsored video but I’ve visited Tada Kids Cafe before and in this particular week I was there twice with Felix 🤣 all opinions are completely my own. I really do highly recommend it for parents and their littles!

contents.desc: My first Personal Colour Analysis by @JennyP at Studio Peona currently located in Concord West. Studio Peona is Australia’s first Colour Analysis Studio using the Korean Colour Method and not only did I learn about my true skin tone and the best and worst colour palette to bring out my natural features, I even learned about what makeup shades and colours to use, how to pick the right jewellery tones and nail polish colours.

Jenny was so thorough and extremely patient with all my questions (especially considering I brought my baby with me too!) I highly recommend this if you have absolutely no idea about which wardrobe and makeup choices suit you best or if you’re like me and you’ve lost all sense of style through motherhood 😆 thank you for such a helpful Colour Analysis Jenny! ❤️
